data.one_liner: Load and cache network images to disk and memory to avoid display delays.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget and manager to load, disk-cache, and memory-precache network images in Flutter applications. It helps prevent flash screens or flickering caused by network image download delays across iOS, Android, and Web.
use_when: You want to avoid network image loading delay and flashing/flickering on screen.
You need dual-layer caching (memory and disk) for network images with explicit precaching control.
avoid_when: You require advanced image manipulation features like cropping or complex transformations.
You are already using a comprehensive image handling solution like cached_network_image.
strengths: Supports dual-layer caching with memory and disk storage.
Provides manual precaching controls via a manager class.
Supports multi-platform including iOS, Android, and Web.
weaknesses: Lacks advanced image transformations, cropping, or editing features.
Relies on manual manager calls for advanced precaching workflows.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is a more widely adopted, robust package for downloading, caching, and displaying network images.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: It provides advanced placeholder and error building strategies for network images.

data.minimal_example:
PrecachedNetworkImage(
  url: 'https://picsum.photos/200',
  width: 200, 
  height: 200,
  precache: true,
  fit: BoxFit.fill,
  placeholder: (context, url) => const Icon(Icons.person),
  errorWidget: (context, url, error) => const Icon(Icons.error),
)
